package.name: wuji_hand2_1_description
package.description: Robot model description package for Wuji Hand 2.1 with URDF, MJCF, and USD assets for simulation and ROS2 visualization. Hand 2.1 keeps the frozen Wuji Hand 2 coordinate contract, is rooted at its arm-flange mount link, and adds a wrist IMU frame. This package provides left and right models with and without covers. Both variants share the hardware meshes.
